answer: By anchoring trust at a trusted seed, personalized PageRank decays geometrically, so adversarial mass cannot wander indefinitely. A spectral gap at a dune separating honest and Sybil vertices yields a barrier whose cut weight is bounded, forcing any voyage of trust across it to attenuate exponentially. EigenTrust aggregates these spectral weights, isolating clusters and preventing propagation into the honest consensus, which converges in O(log(1/ε)) rounds.
